read.thesis: Q4 room nights +9% beat guidance and EBITDA +19%, but 2026 guide is only margin +50bp with $700M reinvestment; supply-side metrics here are customer-service cost per booking down ~10%, not capacity.

triggers.label: Q4 room nights +9%, beat guide
triggers.quote: Our fourth quarter room nights reached 285 million, a 9% year-over-year increase.
triggers.highlight: Our fourth quarter room nights reached 285 million

triggers.label: Customer service cost per booking -10%
triggers.quote: we have about a 10% decline in customer service cost per booking.
triggers.highlight: about a 10% decline in customer service cost per booking

triggers.label: US ADRs and length of stay slightly lower
triggers.quote: we continue to see slightly lower ADRs and a slightly shorter length of stay versus the prior year
triggers.highlight: slightly lower ADRs and a slightly shorter length of stay

guidance.metric: 2026 constant currency gross bookings and revenue growth
guidance.quote: we are targeting full year constant currency top line growth of approximately 100 basis points ahead of our long-term growth algorithm
expanding adjusted EBITDA margins by approximately 50 basis points
adjusted EPS to be up mid-teens
We currently expect first quarter room night growth to be between 5% and 7%.
We expect first quarter gross bookings to increase between 14% and 16%
We expect first quarter adjusted EBITDA growth to be between 10% and 14%.
We expect the Transformation Program to deliver in-year savings of $500 million to $550 million in 2026
we are reinvesting about $700 million above our baseline investments in 2026

prior_guidance_check.metric: Transformation Program run-rate savings $550M by year-end
prior_guidance_check.quote: has already enabled approximately $550 million in annual run rate savings, which was the high end of our prior guidance
exceeding the high end of our guidance range by 3 percentage points

red_flags.label: US ADRs and length of stay slipping
red_flags.quote: we continue to see slightly lower ADRs and a slightly shorter length of stay versus the prior year

red_flags.label: Marketing deleverage +24bp YoY
red_flags.quote: Marketing expense as a percentage of gross bookings was 24 basis points higher year-over-year.

evasions.quote: Trevor, we're not going to give a number going forward.
I don't think we're going to disclose today what it's going to be
